cards.name: RGB Cartographic - Mountains
cards.summary: Relief-map terrain texture: fills the shape with mottled earth tones (dark umber, tan, ochre, cream) broken into ridged, crackled patches like mountains on a shaded relief map, with roughened, feathered edges. On thin outlined letters the texture washes out to pale cream with a few brown flecks, so the letters almost disappear. (Thumbnail: the style applied by script with applyTo to a 5-point star and outlined 'PGD' letters on a light grey plate; not a shipped preview.)
use_for: landmass or mountain areas on an illustrated map
rugged outdoor or adventure badge shape
terrain texture on large background shapes
avoid: type or thin shapes: the texture washes out and letters vanish; use RGB Stone 1 or RGB Wood Grain for textured type
colour control: it replaces the fill with fixed earth tones
final print output at the default raster resolution: its Craquelure, Dry Brush, Feather, Ocean Ripple effects rasterize at Effect > Document Raster Effects Settings, so set 300 ppi before export

small objects on light backgrounds: the pale foam edge disappears

cards.name: RGB Cartographic - Ocean Ridges
cards.summary: Stormy sea-floor texture: blue fill with dark craquelure cracks and horizontal smeared white and grey streaks, heavily feathered and blurred at the edges. Its own Feather (Radius 22 pt) is wider than the strokes of ordinary type, so on the test plate the 120 pt 'PGD' letters faded out completely (alpha 5/255 or less) and only the star shows the look. (Thumbnail: the style applied by script with applyTo to a 5-point star and outlined 'PGD' letters on a mid-grey checker, where white paint shows white and holes show the checker; not a shipped preview.)
use_for: deep-water or sea-floor areas on an illustrated map
moody blue texture on large background shapes
avoid: type: the style's 22 pt Feather fades letters whose strokes are thinner than about 44 pt (120 pt 'PGD' letters came out at alpha 5/255 or less); use it on large shapes or very heavy display type, or lower the Feather radius after applying
crisp edges: the outline is heavily feathered and smeared
final print output at the default raster resolution: its Craquelure, Feather, Rough Pastels effects rasterize at Effect > Document Raster Effects Settings, so set 300 ppi before export
